migration.notes: No mandatory archive schema or Hub JSON migration. Source versions require native frozen-data and whole-state restore validation before release. Hermes reasoning cost is charged once; token buckets are preserved. Codex parser caches reparse once. Restore a complete closed pre-deployment state snapshot with its old image. Automatic rollback requires a NAS-local rehearsal receipt for this exact version and digest pair. Cross-v0.70 Hermes reasoning cost corrections require reviewed manual acceptance: production automatic controller remains fail-closed on any frozen cost difference. Synthetic manual-path receipts are not production receipts. Agent archive publication strictly rejects read/write errors and malformed rows before accepting usage. No accounting-rule or storage-format change from v0.71.0-01; frozen usage and cost must remain equal. v0.72.0 changes optional Cursor quota display and OpenCode metadata/detail reads only; Hermes token/cache/reasoning/cost/history and persisted formats are unchanged. No new source or quota provider is enabled. v0.73.0 preserves SQLite and Hub formats; completed full scans may replace corrected session totals including zero. New pinned parser and matched timing fields follow official v0.73.0. Existing source/privacy switches stay unchanged. A user-authorized upgrade without backup cannot use snapshot restoration; never clear state or blindly downgrade migrated data. v0.74.0 preserves persisted formats and privacy defaults. Tokscale 4.20.0 fork upgrades cache envelopes and rebuilds Codex parser 20 once, retaining stored usage. Provider-scoped pricing and Grok disjoint reasoning follow the new official baseline. All listed sources are candidate validation targets until their native frozen-data and full-state restore gates pass; publication remains gated.
